# oprobe

> oprobe is a profiler for Apache OpenDAL operators. It shows what an `Operator` (a storage service plus its layer stack and read/write options) really does on the wire, request by request and stage by stage (queue, connect, send, time to first byte, body, retry backoff); names the one OpenDAL change that fixes each finding; and proves that change with an interleaved A/B test on goodput or p99. It is a CLI with an app (native window or terminal), plus `oprobe-trace`, an OpenDAL layer that writes `.oprobe` profiles from production.

Agents should use machine output: every command prints exactly one JSON document with `-o json` (stdout carries only the result). Errors are `{"type":"error","error":{"code","message","hint","retryable","docs"}}` with stable dotted codes. Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 runtime failure, 2 usage/config, 3 prove refuted the change, 4 budget exceeded, 5 safety refusal, 130 interrupted. Plan with `--dry-run` before profiling a real bucket, set budgets (`--max-requests`, `--max-bytes`, `--max-duration`), and use `--read-only` / `--existing PREFIX` when writes are not allowed. oprobe never prompts.

Commands: `oprobe run OPERATOR…` (profile; several operators run on the same workload), `oprobe demo` (= `run lab://demo`, no credentials), `oprobe prove RUN [FINDING] [--with PATH=VALUE] [--objective goodput|p99]` (the proven layer diff, as Rust and TOML), `oprobe show [RUN|FILE] [--list] [--rm RUN…] [--detail] [--by stage|api|conn]`, `oprobe lab [SCENARIO]`. An OPERATOR is a URL (`s3://bucket/prefix`, `gcs://`, `azblob://`, `fs://`, `memory://`, `lab://SCENARIO`), an operator file (`op.toml`) or a configured name. A RUN is a run id, unique id prefix, `last`, `last~N` or a label; `show` also takes a `.oprobe` file. The agent skill is `skills/oprobe/SKILL.md`; JSON Schemas are in `schemas/`.

## Docs

- [Getting started](https://github.com/hxddh/oprobe/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md): install, the demo, prove, your bucket
- [Concepts](https://github.com/hxddh/oprobe/blob/main/docs/concepts.md): operator, workload, profile, finding, remedy, prove
- [op.toml](https://github.com/hxddh/oprobe/blob/main/docs/operator.md): the operator file, `--set` paths, the config file
- [CLI reference](https://github.com/hxddh/oprobe/blob/main/docs/cli.md): the four commands and every flag
- [Reading the profile](https://github.com/hxddh/oprobe/blob/main/docs/reading-the-profile.md): the brief, the profile's sections, how it is measured, JSON
- [Embedding](https://github.com/hxddh/oprobe/blob/main/docs/embedding.md): `oprobe-trace` in your own operator, the overhead benchmark
